translations.description_clean:
For Stellaris: 4.3.*

Adds many new Planetary Wonders, with custom icons, images and events.
Wonders are buildings that take up a district slot, a lot of resources and time, but provide many jobs and bonuses.
Only one allowed per planet, more can be unlocked by the new Ascension Perk.
Only Void Dwellers (or with Voidborne) can build them on Habitats.
Every Wonder is planet-unique, and some are empire-unique.

Japanese translation - "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2352049755] Planetary Wonders" by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198097877684]FebHare
If you enjoy my work you can [url=https://ko-fi.com/namfoodle]buy me a coffee at Ko-Fi!
Features
Wonders
Space Elevator
- Adds Clerks and Merchants (or Logistics Drones) and many different bonuses.

Research Wonders: Each is Empire Unique. Complete Special Event Chains to upgrade them.
- Particle Supercollider -> Interdimensional Collider;
- Domed City -> Psionic Observatory;
- Abyssal Test Crater -> Metal Vivarium;

Astronomical Model Bureau (Empire Unique)
- Bureaucrats, Administrators and more administration bonuses.
- Complete the event chain to upgrade to Aligned Galactic Model.

Enigma Engine (For Machine Empires, requires Synthetic Dawn)
- Empire Unique and only on Machine Worlds.
- Adds Enigma Operators, that produce research and unity.
- Unlocks new mysterious Enigma Technology.

Solipsist Debate Hall (For Hive Minds, requires Utopia)
- Empire Unique and only on Hive Worlds.
- Adds a variety of jobs per pop.
- Allows for Debates Events where I pretend to understand philosophy the empire gains bonuses as the gestalt debates with itself or plays chess.

Guardian Angel
- Adds Soldiers and Enforcers.
- Creates a Flying Fortress army to defend the planet.
- Special features for times of peace.
- Upgrades to Stellar Sentinel.

Resource Wonders:
- Erebus Project -> Erebus Fracking Plant
- Helios Tower -> Helios Translucer Obelisk
- Demetrius Cornucopia -> Demetrius Chemical Garden

- Each adds Miners, Technicians and Farmers respectively and boosts those jobs.
- Each upgrade is Empire Unique and adds jobs that produce rare resources.

Mantle Crucible
- Adds Metallurgists and Artisans.
- Decreases habitability, increases alloy and consumer goods production.
- Can upgrade to Titan Forge which is Empire Unique, provides only Metallurgists and unlocks the War Titan army.
- OR can upgrade to Industrial Hearth which is Empire Unique, provides new Poly-Artisan jobs (that produce consumer goods and unity) and unlocks special technologies.

Pavilion of Wonders
- Adds Entertainers and Culture Workers.
- Unlocks decision to host art exhibitions across the empire (even more with the Mega Art Installation Megastructure).
- Can upgrade to Fair of Worlds which is Empire Unique and only for Xenophiles, improves the exhibitions and unlocks a campaign.
- OR can upgrade to Museum of the Grotesque which is Empire Unique and only for Xenophobes, improves the exhibitions and unlocks a campaign.

Holy Reliquary (Spiritualists only)
- Adds Priests (and a Relic Keeper when all artifacts are sanctified).
- Unlocks an edict and a decision to access the Reliquary, a new menu to sanctify 7 artifacts corresponding to each (base) tradition.
- Each Artifact has unique modifiers that can be changed at any time.
- Sanctify artifacts by spending Unity, change modifiers by spending Influence.

The Grand Archive (Materialists only)
- Adds Grand-Archivists (and a Master Archivist when all collections are assembled).
- Unlocks an edict and a decision to access the Archive, a new menu to assemble 9 collections corresponding to each research field.
- Each Collection adds a Planetary Deposit that boosts research and unlocks unique techs.
- Assemble collections by spending Unity and completing special projects, unlock their techs by spending Influence.

Transplanetary Logistics Network (Egalitarian only)
- Unlocks decision to improve infrastructure (Planetary Features).
- There are 4 types of infrastructure and each has 4 levels.
- The last level requires a specific Wonder in that planet (like Guardian Angel for Crisis Responders).

Forbidden City (Authoritarian only)
- Unlocks decision to improve infrastructure (Planetary Features).
- There are 3 types of infrastructure and each has 4 levels, but one is only available on the capital.
- Each ethic has its own infrastructure too.

Festival Plaza (Pacifist only)
- Unlocks decisions to make Peace Festivals.
- Each Peace Festival increases the rank of a Peace Stability country modifier.
- All modifiers/festivals are suspended during wars.

Martial Avenue (Militarist only)
- Unlocks decisions to make Martial Parades.
- Each Martial Parades increases the rank of a War Drive country modifier.
- War Drive can cause debuffs if too high, but turns into War Lust (no debuffs) during wars.

Department of Xenoeconomics (Megacorps only)
- Increases trade value and branch office value.
- Unlocks unique Branch Office Buildings that exploit other countries ethics in the name of profit.
- New Branch Office Buildings are planet-unique and restricted to 1 on each foreign empire.

Panopticon
- For Penal Colonies (or Police State empires).
- Unlocks the Panspectron edict.

Blossoming Preserve
- For Gaia and Hive Wolds.
- Unlocks the Harmonious Blossom edict.

Nostalgia Paradise
- For Resort Worlds and Rogue Servitors.
- Choose a theme for the resort.

Unhallowed Necropolis
- For Tomb/Relic Wolds and Necro empires.
- Allows the designation of Mausoleum Worlds.

Feasting Grounds
- For Devouring Swarm/Terravore empires.
- Allows a decision to start banquets, that when completed give bonuses.

Living Spire (Unlocked by AP - for Regular Empires)
- Has 4 stages that gives bonuses to housing, growth and amenities.
- Adopts a designation when concluded.

Conduit of Unity (Unlocked by AP - for Gestalts Empires)
- Has 2 stages and unlocks Decision to build Planetary Deposits.
- Planetary Deposits represent Integrated Infras

UPDATED 26/04/2021 (see changelog)
DISCORD: https://discord.gg/sbd3nWnAud 

This mod adds a bunch of new federation types, perks and laws. Here's a short description for Federation types:

PROSPERITY BLOC (Egalitarian): This federation emphasizes on mutual cooperation between its members to assure a rapid industrial and economic growth to enhance social welfare.
Inspired by IRL economic blocs such as the Benelux and the European Coal and Steel Community. Gets massive build speed bonuses and access to strategic resources even if they aren't exploitable within your borders.

DEFENSIVE COALITION (Pacifist): A federation whose main purpose is to ensure the territorial integrity of all its member-states through heavy investments in defense.
Inspired by the historical birth of the US from the union of the Thirteen Colonies. It's a Federation where you can't maintain an independent fleet but allows access to an unlimited Federation Fleet.

DIPLOMATIC ASSOCIATION (Xenophile): A congregation of many entities with common interests who adopt the same agenda to increase their soft power and allow for a more profound impact within the realm of intergalactical politics.
Inspired by unions made by countries who wish to strenghten their influence upon world politics, such as the Association of Southeast Asian Nations and the new East African Federation. Makes members, specially the President, pretty strong when dealing with the Galactic Community.

SACRED COMMUNION (Spiritualist): Members of this federation are bound together by a divine mission to preserve and share the Truth by whatever means it may be deemed necessary.
Inspired by religious alliances such as the Organization of Islamic Cooperation. Focuses on internal stability, but also grants a Deus Vult casus belli which rallies all spiritualist empires in the galaxy towards your cause.

COMMON DETENTE (Xenophobic): A detente is an unstable relation rather than an alliance, in which parties forfeit a small portion of their intergalactical ambitions in order to ease relations with one another and prevent escalation.
Inspired by non-friendly alliances such as the Concert of Europe, the Chinese Front in World War 2, and some Korean proposed unification programs. It's a federation so difficult to maintain that being the President isn't even worth it (this is reflected by the leader getting mali instead of benefits).

COSMIC MUTUALISM (Hivemind): A collaborative relationship between different hiveminds who view themselves as Organs of a galactical organism striving for evolution.
Inspiration speaks for itself. It's like a collective of organisms forming something greater - think cells making up your body.

There's also currently three new sets of laws with circumstantially useful events, such as:
- Influencing Policies of other nations;
- Defending your Associates from attackers;
- Stealing diplo weight from your members.

Currently, we are working on adding more events that affect XP gain and cohesion, as well as to make the Federation experience less boring and artificial.

This is pretty much the first mod I've publicly released, so make sure to give feedback on suggestions and/or bugs, this will certainly help improve the quality of the content and make sure the mod stays alive.

COMPATIBILITY:
- REQUIRES FEDERATION DLC.
- Not Ironman compatible.
- Not compatible with mods replacing the "common\federation_law_categories\01_categories.txt" file.
- Testing save game compatibility. Should work but a few laws might cause problems. If you want to try it out, backup your save and message me if you've faced any issues.

New Civics

Additionally, 5 base game civics have been enhanced with expanded features. Even short summaries cannot be contained in the character limit so see [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/901988941/1692662484253758433/]the dedicated civics thread for detailed descriptions.

New Governments

Around 80 new governments (I may have lost count at some point!) spread across nearly all authority types and combining vanilla and GVP-added civics. They are also listed in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/901988941/1318835718938058107/]their own thread. The requirements for making them are in the first reply to that thread.

Special Thanks

ICONS
Wanna give a HUGE THANK YOU to [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/meltup/]Meltup for making unique icons for the new civics. They look cool and I am super happy someone stepped up to help out with this.

Other Contributors

This mod only adds new things to the game, in new files. There's no possibility of my mod conflicting with another due to both editing base game files, and will only conflict with other mods if for some reason another mod has files with the exact same names in the same places as this in mod. However, if a mod radically changes the way ethics work (especially renaming the base ethics), compatibility will be shaky at best. There's also no guarantee that combinations of mod-added features will "play nice" or be balanced against/with each other in game.

translations.description_clean:
//i.imgur.com/QV4FTm5.png
Ever wanted to be able to shut down access to the L-Cluster while an Awakened Empire, Horde, Crisis, or some other empire threatening you is ongoing? Just want to be Tall but isolated in the L-Cluster? Ever wished that the Gray Tempest was more of a threat with the sweet rewards of Nanite technologies, being able to build Nanite ships, use the Gatebuilder weapons and bombard worlds into Nanite Worlds, then terraform them into something useful (and Xenoless)?

//i.imgur.com/h6cFkn5.png
A Deadlier Tempest
The Gray Tempest has been improved, not only do they now make use of the higher end-ship technologies, but also once every two months their fleets will spawn a ship to replace the numbers that the fleet has lost in combat. However, if they do not have a mothership class within the fleet, then they have lost their spawning ability. How this works is that the fleets will keep spawning new ships, until they have reached a fleet size of 11. If it is the mid-game this changes to 21, and finally at the late-game, their fleets can reach a size of 41 ships in addition. Once at the late-game, they have a very small chance to spawn a Mothership class instead of an Interdictor class. Additional fleets start spawning once the mid-game or late-game points are reached, meaning you in a race against time to end the threat quickly before it gets out of control. (Spawning chance is now ca. 57%, from vanilla around 36%. If you want more, take the Never Empty L-Cluster mod.)

Control Access to the L-Cluster
Finally, once you research the L-Cluster Access Control technology, you will get a unique decision, that allows you to close or open the access to the L-Cluster. However, in order to do so, you must have also the (Gateway Activation) technology researched and be in control of Terminal Egress. The decisions are at your capital.
On the plus side, if there is ever a crisis you cannot beat, you now have a safe retreat while the galaxy burns behind you. (I recommend getting the Gigastructural Engineering mod to build all that population space you're going to need for all those refugees or just your pops one or the other.)
● Stand-alone mod: [url=//steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/2047817384]L-Cluster Access

Buildable L-Gates
You can build L-Gates, however the L-Gates must be built at a black hole. The visual representation of the two states is now conspicuous like normal gateways. (In fact the vanilla game has already unused/inactive entries for this, as I see now this was used in the first release of 2.1 Niven, if you see old release pictures with blue gates.)
● also in L-Cluster Access

Nanite Technologies
For your hard struggle against the now deadly Gray Tempest, not only do you get access to the L-Cluster's resources, but new Nanite technologies such as being able to research, the means to produce the Nanite resources yourself, the weapons used by the Gray Tempest and others. You must have finished the L-Gate chain and Nanite resources in order to research and use the Nanite technologies.

Buildable Nanite Ships
Once researched you will be able to design and build Nanite ships. Now these ships do not have an upkeep, but their designs are somewhat inflexible, they still use up fleetcap and can only be build from starbases that have the Nanite Foundry building. This building is expensive and has a massive upkeep just to keep it running.

Nanite Bombardment
Once researched, this bombardment stance works much in the same way as the Armageddon Bombardment stance, except for a Tomb World, the planet is instead turned into a Nanite World. The bombardment requires you to have researched the technology and have either the Indiscriminate or Armageddon Bombardment polices.

Terraformable Nanite Worlds
Once researched you will be able to terraform Nanite Worlds into what ever world you wish.

Nanite Bonuses
This mod also includes a number of technologies that give empire wide bonuses. With the technologies that give the old Nanite resources bonuses are just the tip of the ice asteroid. Bonuses such as increased ship hull and armor with and small (+1 hull +2 armor) regen, faster building and cheaper ships, etc.

Nanicist and Nanite Drone Jobs
These unique jobs allow an empire to create Nanites for their use. In order to build the buildings that produce their jobs, all you need is the Nanite Transmutation tech (vanilla technology), and you can start building them.

Nanite Replicators Buildings
With the help of some energy and Nanites you can build buildings that can create food or raw minerals. Buildable once you have the Nanite Transmutation technology.

L-Drakes
Are a little stronger and friendly to the Tempest as they have in vanilla only about 1/30 strength of an adult Ether Drake. (Spawning chance is now 100%, from vanilla around 21%) Some mechanical space guardians are neutral too.. New matching [url=//stellaris.paradoxwikis.com/images/f/f1/Evt_space_dragon_young.png]event picture.
The Gray
Has various types of occurrence chance of up to 100%due to the removal of the empty cluster result, also slightly strengthened as army and ship. If you want the maximum spawn chance, you can get the [url=//steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/2030416116]Never Empty L-Cluster or Crisis Manager - Mid-Game Edition. s.b.

More…
AFE Gatebuilder, Tempest can capture ships from mechanical enemies…

//i.imgur.com/m6bb49v.png
Should be savegame compat, except parts of the built-in compat for the [url=//steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/2491573516]Crisis Manager.
For more see [url=//steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2028826064/2152098711355881521/]this thread.

If you remove this mod on an ongoing game – before the L-Cluster was opened – this could lead to inoperable deactivated L-Gates (if not, use L-Cluster Access instead).

WIth this mini-mod, ethics of randomly generated AI empires are more evenly weighted to appear, so there’s less of a chance you’ll be surrounded by hostile empires as in vanilla. It's still possible to be surrounded by hostile AI if you have bad RNG - it's just less likely compared to vanilla.

This mod is NOT compatible with any mod that modifies vanilla ethics, specifically the 00_ethics.txt file. Credits to Eris for the original implementation; while my tweaks are a little different, I was inspired by their nice mod, Ethics Bias Begone: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2027672577

Because Ethics Bias Begone is unfortunately outdated (as of me releasing this mod), I decided to take matters into my own hands and upload this for the convenience of others.


How It Works

Contrary to a common urban myth in the fandom, the devs have said there isn't any code that makes it so empires spawn with ethoses that are opposite yours. However, AI empires are more likely to spawn with aggressive personalities, which may be the reason for this misconception that AI empires are scripted to hate you. The devs said this was done to make the game more interesting from their perspective. I personally don't find this interesting and more tiring than anything, so I made this for myself. Due to RNG, it's still possible to spawn in a galaxy full of jerks, but ideally the chances are more balanced.

If you’re interested in how the code works so you can adjust it yourself, basically, each ethos is assigned a certain weight value in the 00_ethics.txt file that influence how likely they are to appear. For example, most ethoses are assigned values of 150 and 100 for their fanatic and non-fanatic variants respectively.

However, the Militarist ethos has weight values of 250 and 150 for fanatic and non-fanatic variants respectively, meaning militarist empires are more common. Meanwhile, Xenophile ethos has weight values of 100 and 66 for fanatic and non-fanatic variants respectively, meaning they’ll be less common. Pacifist ethos is even worse, with weight values of 33 and 66 for fanatic and non-fanatic variants respectively, meaning they’re kind of rare.

This mod simply changes the weight values for all ethoses to be 150 and 100 for fanatic and non-fanatic variants, so that Militarist/Xenophile/Pacifist distribution is more in line with the other ethoses. (Ethics Bias Begone, meanwhile, changes all the values to 500, but I decided to keep a semblance of Paradox’s original design of adding some weight to fanatic variants.)

Federations brought us the fancy new Origin system! You want more?
- I've got you covered: This mod adds Even More Origins to the number of vanilla ones!

Origin Description & Features
Below is a list of all included Origins, describing their features. Due to the steam workshop character limit I had to drop the flavorful background stories, but you should definitely check them all out in game!

Back to the Future
Start in a maximum sized Trinary System on a size 26 Relic World orbited by two Relic Moons (size 1 and 11). Your species has the Relic World Habitability.

Ecosystem Integration
Start on a Hive World.

Eldest Sibling
Start with up to two primitive civilizations in your home system. At the start of the game you can choose whether to spawn one or two primitive civilizations and if they're of your own species or randomly generated ones.

Endeavour to Enlightenment
Your leaders have a 20% chance to retain their level. Their leader experience gain is increased by 200%, and your effective councilor skill is increased by 2 as well. Agendas progress 20% faster and last 20% longer. Your leaders have a 20% increased upkeep and cost 200% more to hire.

Fratricide
Paradox had dropped this idea from among their planned Origins - so here's me rushing to the rescue: This allows you to start in a system together with a Tomb World. Funnily enough they did add a picture sprite for this already.

Legacy of Nine Suns
Start on a size 30 home world that orbits a Black Hole. Oh, and 9 different stars are part of this system. 
Feast your eyes on this glorious home system! 
I recommend reloading a few times to check out different effects (depending on the angle it generates you can end up with different camera tints - blue is rarest). 
Naturally, living in the presence of so many stars is dangerous: The Superflare event chain will fire for your home world.
If you are also subscribed to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1121692237]Gigastructural Engineering, then your civilization will have thought of building a Birch World around the core of the collided galaxy - and if you don't block it with other megastructures - you will be able to build it here, in your home system after taking the Ascension Perk.

Out of Sight, Out of Mind
Start with a Subterranean Civilization on your home world. This gives powerful bonuses in the form of additional districts or some districts and powerful jobs at the cost of losing quite a bit of science income for a while. If you aren't careful, they might take over the planet. And you don't want that, do you?

The Chosen One
Your ruler is the Chosen One, an immortal, level 10 leader. They will allow you to start researching Psionic Theory right from the beginning. Though you probably shouldn't do that as it would take about 72 months.

Walking On Eggshells
Start with a Voidspawn growing inside your Home Planet. It will hatch and destroy your empire capital.
You will be able to pick how long it takes at the start of the game. Choose from options between certain annihilation at 1 year and the 'very challenging' timeframe of 100 years. 
List of possible options:

[*] 1 year (impossible, if you do not get a habitable planet in a neighbouring system - and the default ones are disabled by this origin / I haven't been able to clear this myself, yet)
[*] 1.5 years (slightly less punishing, allows you to colonize a planet a little farther away)
[*] 2 years (you don't have to get really lucky to be able to find and colonize a planet with this - build an extra science ship, explore until you find the first planet and go for that one immediately)
[*] 3 years
[*] 4 years
[*] 5 years (recommended, you have some time to explore, but will probably still lose all of your starting population)
[*] 7 years (recommended, slightly less punishing - you might even save a few pops)
[*] 10 years (recommended, if you don't think losing most of your pops is cool)
[*] 15 years
[*] 25 years
[*] 100 years (for everybody who would just like to fight a voidspawn without a particularly challenging start)

The screenshots are from the 1.5 and 2 years options.

Future Development & Compatibility Notes
I am still adding more Origins to the mod (albeit slowly), as well as working on supporting compatibility with other mods, so please feel free to keep any ideas coming my way! 
A specific mod you like doesn't work with this one? Report in detail, and I will fix the issue! Thank you for all the support!

Compatibility
Only the latest version of the game is supported, as several Origins use solar_system_initializers and the mod interface has been changed for these with 2.6.3

As of Mod Version 1.5.1 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=819148835]Planetary Diversity is fully compatible!
It is now possible to use the "Eldest Sibling" Origin with a home world from that mod.
Any randomly generated worlds will also spawn using the Planetary Diversity list of normal and rare planet classes.

As of Mod Version 1.6.0 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1121692237]Gigastructural Engineering will allow you to build a Birch World around the supermassive black hole featured by the "Legacy of Nine Suns" origin (a new save game is required).

All of the added features above are optional. There's no need to subscribe to any more mods, if you don't want to do so in the first place.

This mod should also be fully compatible with almost any other mod (even those adding more origins). No vanilla files were touched. There's one small exception: I have overwritten the following event: colony.50 # Allowed Subterranean Civilization to fire on empire capitals

Features
✔ Twelve unique covert operations to expand your intelligence arsenal:


[*]Discredit Galactic Envoy  
Undermine a rival’s reputation - not by war, but with whispers and scandal.
Sabotage their voice in the Galactic Community and turn trust into doubt.
Reputation is power. And power can be undone.

[*]Undermine Central Control  
Sow unrest, disrupt cohesion and fracture the very foundation of enemy rule.
Destabilize empires without firing a shot just pull the strings until they snap.
Empires fall - not by force, but by fracture.

[*]Infiltrate Fleet Command  
Cripple enemy fleets by disrupting their command structure.
Sabotage doctrine, fracture coordination and leave their armadas in disarray.
You don’t need to destroy the fleet. Just confuse the orders.

[*]Smuggle Predators  
Trigger a covert outbreak of alien predators on enemy worlds.
Destabilize colonies, disrupt economies, and watch chaos escalate into planetary crisis.
No bombs. No armies. Just teeth in the dark.

[*]Branch Shutdown  
Dismantle foreign corporate footholds with a multi-stage spy operation and crisis-style planetary situation.
Destabilize branch offices, trigger sabotage events, and choose how far you're willing to go.
They profit from our people. We'll make their presence unprofitable

[*]Narrative Shift  
Subtly shift an empire’s ethics through a multi-phase spy operation and a dynamic empire situation.
Manipulate beliefs, ignite factional tension, and watch their ideology bend from within.
We do not conquer their worlds - we conquer their beliefs.

[*]Covert Shield Protocol  
Protect allied empires from enemy espionage through a four-stage joint operation.
Increases counter-espionage, boosts diplomatic trust, and grants intelligence bonuses to the initiator.
True security is forged in silence - not in treaties, but in trust.

[*]Suppress Insurgency  
Stabilize volatile empires through covert influence. Ends active revolts on high-crime or unstable planets, boosts stability and happiness, and reduces governing ethic attraction across the empire.
The streets are quiet again. Not because the people are content - but because someone made the noise go away. 

[*]Shifting Allegiance
Realign your vassals. This covert operation lets Overlords trigger a dynamic situation that sways loyalty, shifts ethics, and ignites political tension. Multiple approaches and random events shape the outcome.
Loyalty is not given - it's shaped.

Undermine your Overlord’s grip through covert subversion. As a vassal, you can trigger an escalating situation within the Overlord’s empire - eroding loyalty, unity, and political control without open rebellion. Choose to destabilize the center from the shadows.

Destabilize rival empires by removing their leader through a surgical covert strike. Successful elimination weakens loyalty, disrupts governance, and reduces ideological cohesion. Failure may reveal your hand, or bolster the enemy's defenses.  
History remembers rulers. We choose who gets remembered.

Secretly bolster a foreign empire at war by providing hidden fleets and logistical advantages. Choose between three support tiers (Low/Mid/High) with escalating Alloy and Influence costs, granting powerful temporary military buffs. Risk of exposure adds diplomatic consequences.  
Wars are not always won by those who fight them - but by those who fund them from the shadows.

translations.description_clean:
Updated to 4.4.*
This is a continuation of the Worthy Ascension Perks mod by Only Karlos, which aimed to improve the less interesting and underwhelming Ascension Perks.

Worthy
Ascension Perks are great, You've got your fairly powerful Perks such as One Vision or Defender of the Galaxy, high impact Crisis and Ascension Paths, and then there's... Executive Vigor.
Obviously, not all Ascension Perks are equal. Some fall off over time, others are barely worth picking to begin with. Saying some are underwhelming would be an understatement. 
That's where Worthy Ascension Perks comes in!

After all, choosing a Perk should be a game-defining moment and not feel like you're just picking from leftover scraps. The first and last pick are especially lackluster, early on you have limited options, and by your 8th perk you've already grabbed the essentials. Now, to make them stand out more, I'm introducing Ambitions and Capstones.

- Ambition Effects activate for your first Ascension Perk
- Capstone Effects activate for your final Ascension Perk
- By nature of this, only one Ambition and one Capstone can be active
- Perks can have both, just one, or neither Effect

Every perk choice should feel impactful, so now perks have more balance changes. Some Perks have scaling effects that increase in power with each AP you unlock. These max out at 8 Perks, even if you have mods which increase the cap.

Changes
[url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sR_hiUGNMuvyMkMA68VW82z3dzKAQAUlDPqwzoNaRbA/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.rpgdxuc83946]Full Documentation here

Compatibility
Supported by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2821711162]! Sartek Tradition - Ascension Perk Merger. If you encounter any incompatibilities with other mods, this will likely fix them.

Suggestions
If you feel like certain Perks are too weak, too uninteresting or have other issues leave some feedback below.

Civilian Trade for update 1.8.*

No big feature changes or anything for this update!
*Not been tested with Synthetic Dawn Story pack but I don't anticipate any problems, do let me know if you find any. 

 Features:  

> Trade planets (planets with pop members of the prosperity faction) produce an 'aura' that send bonuses to planets within range (based on population size)
	> Foreign planets will receive "Foreign trade" which includes a small does of xenophili attraction.
> Various trade auras depending on planetary edicts

> Trade ships spawned from trade planets that run stops to nearby planets 
	> Trade ships number of stops determined by the size of starting planet
	> Trade ships deposit resources directly to the empire upon arrival, along with a reduction in commodity goods for a shot time 
		> Some planetary edicts can influence theses deposits 
	> If destroyed by enemies they provide a small amount of resources to the empire who killed them.
		
		
----

I think this version will also be a bit better on frame rate since the number of ships will be slightly lower overall in the galaxy, since each empire will vary more and the ships disappear after they are done with their stops. 
There is still a limit on total per empire to keep it from absolutely blowing up.
The trade ships are also regular civilian ships that are part of your empire and appear in the civilian ship outliner. You can direct them a tiny bit but they will instantly go back on course.

With the way it is set up currently you don't have to do anything, it all runs in the background basically. Decisions you make will affect them but there is no real direct control you put on them.
This also means that it works perfectly with the AI.

 Hopes and plans for the future: 

> A separate civilian trader faction.
	> there are some specific things I'd like a trader faction to want that don't fit perfectly with the prosperity faction.
	> Having the happiness of the faction effect trade ships/bonuses
> Some connection to the unity system
> War Demands
> Events



 Localization:  
All of these are just English for the moment. Since so much changed basically all the text has changed and I couldn't keep any of the great translations you guys gave me.
There isn't a lot of text this time around so translating shouldn't be too hard. If you want to help I'll post the localization file in a discussion and you can just post it there.

German: English
French: English
Russian: Complete
Brazilian: English
Polish: English

Important for removing the mod! 

Pause the game.
Open the console " ` " 
type in " event civtrade.66 "
Hit enter and all the trade ships should disappear. Then just save a reload.

translations.description_zh_current: 本模组面向 1.8.* 版本更新，为星系添加民用贸易场景，让银河更「活」。核心机制：繁荣派系人口居住的贸易星球会产生「光环」，向范围内（按人口规模计算）的行星发送加成；外国行星会收到「外来贸易」，附带少量排外主义吸引力；多种贸易光环取决于行星法令；贸易星球会生成民用商船，沿途停靠附近行星，停靠次数由起始星球规模决定；商船抵达时直接向帝国存入资源，并在短时间内减少商品（消费品）；部分行星法令可影响这些入账；商船若被敌人击毁，会给击杀者提供少量资源。性能方面：由于各帝国差异更大、商船跑完即消失，本版本整体帧率更好，且每个帝国仍有总数上限防止爆炸。商船属于你帝国的常规民用船，会出现在民用船侧边栏；整套系统基本在后台自动运行，天然适配 AI。未来计划：独立的民用商人派系、派系幸福度影响贸易等。注意：本模组版本较老。

This MOD increases the chance of Leviathan spawns.

* All Leviathans can be found in galaxies with more than 400 Stars.
* In galaxies less than 400 Stars, not all Leviathans may appear.
* This MOD only works at start a New Game.

Limitations in a Small Galaxy
In galaxies smaller than 400 Stars, all types of Leviathans may not appear, depending on the settings at the start of the game.
In the case of 400 Stars (Galaxy Size: Small), only about 2 types of Leviathan will usually appear if you do not use the MOD.
With this MOD, you can expect to encounter 5 or more types of Leviathan, but please note that depending on your starting settings, there is no guarantee of this and not all types will always appear. This may be due to failure to spawn.
Galaxies larger than 600 Stars (Galaxy Size: Medium or larger) do not show such a problem.

Supported version: 4.4.1+

translations.description_clean:
UPDATE:
Updated for Asimov Patch


Purpose: 
Add a classical sci-fi idea, that also makes sense from a sci-fi economical point of view: the mining of asteroids and all its related themes.

Inspiration: 
I developed this mod heavily inspired by the Expanse books and an assidious reading of Atomic Rockets.


Features
- Adds the possibility to colonize asteroids (but no way to raise their habitability, it stays at 0%).
- Adds a new life support system building restricted to the asteroids that add habitability (80%).
- Added a range for asteroid size (between 5 and 7).
- Increased Ceres size in the pre-scripted solar system to 7.
- Added a planet bonus specific to asteroids (+25% mine tile yield, -30% building cost, -5% spaceships building cost, -25% ship building time and -25% spaceport module cost, -25% spaceport build cost and -50% border extrusion.)

New Events
- Growth of independent asteroid mining that can improve mining yield in asteroid colonies.
- Possibility to focus on searching for certain types of asteroids, carbonaceous ones can be useful for further colonization effort, while metallic ones are more attractive for the industry.
- Asteroid trajectory accident: accident can happen when you handle ten kilometers sized rocks, and it can have dire consequences.
- Possibility to create an orbit guard to monitor asteroids and prevent world ending scenarios.
- Possible death of the population if the life support building is damaged.


Planned Features
- Teach the AI to colonize asteroids: Right now, it would involve fiddling with the define value of AI rationality regarding planet colonization and would have too many unwanted consequences.
- Genetic drift for the population living on the asteroids
- City Visuals for Asteroids Colonies
- Political events and crisis regarding the rock-rats and their world ending powers.
- Closed ecological life support systems related events (price of air, corrupt governors, accident in the supply of critical elements for the colony...)


Compatibility
Incompatible mod files:
- 00_on_actions
- 00_planet_classes
- 00_planet_modifiers
- prescripted_species_systems
- 00_tile_blockers
translations.title_zh_current: 小行星带（The Belt）
translations.summary_zh_current: 受《苍穹浩瀚》启发，让玩家殖民小行星，并围绕采矿、生命维持与轨道事故展开事件链。
translations.description_zh_current:
• 灵感来自《苍穹浩瀚》（The Expanse）系列小说与 Atomic Rockets 资料，主题为小行星采矿
• 新增小行星殖民能力（小行星宜居度保持 0% 无法提升），并提供仅限小行星的生命维持系统建筑（+80% 宜居度）
• 小行星尺寸范围设为 5-7，预设太阳系中谷神星尺寸提升至 7
• 新增小行星专属星球加成（采矿地块产出 +25%、建筑成本 -30%、舰船建造成本 -5%、舰船建造时间 -25%、太空港模块成本 -25%、太空港建造成本 -25%、边境扩张 -50%）
• 新增事件：独立小行星采矿业成长可提升矿场产出；可按类型搜寻小行星（碳质利于殖民、金属利于工业）；小行星轨道事故可能带来严重后果；可组建轨道警卫队监视小行星、防范灭世风险；生命维持建筑受损可能导致人口死亡
• 作者列出的计划功能（AI 殖民小行星、基因漂变、小行星殖民地城市外观、政治事件与危机、闭环生态维持系统事件等）尚未实现
• 兼容性：覆盖 00_on_actions、00_planet_classes、00_planet_modifiers、prescripted_species_systems、00_tile_blockers 等原版文件，与修改同名文件的 MOD 不兼容
translations.gameplay_zh_current: 订阅后启用即可殖民小行星；必须在岛上……不，在小行星上建造专属生命维持建筑才能维持人口生存，注意该建筑一旦受损可能导致人口死亡。与其他修改同类原版文件的 MOD 存在冲突风险。
translations.reviews_zh_current: 订阅 4168、收藏 962。作者自述设定兼顾经典科幻与经济逻辑，事件链丰富（采矿成长、轨道事故、轨道警卫队等）。需要注意：该 MOD 已较老（更新至 Asimov 补丁时期），覆盖多个原版文件，与新版本或同类 MOD 可能冲突；作者列出的部分功能仅为计划、尚未实装。
